|date=[[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> (48:1)<ref name="Months">The [[Battle of Nam Chorios]] occurs in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], while the [[Battle of Orinda]] occurs in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]]. According to the ''Essential Chronology'' and the ''New Essential Chronology'', Nam Chorios occurs a month after Orinda. The only way for Orinda to occur in 12 ABY and Nam Chorios in 13 ABY is if Nam Chorios was within a month of the division between the two years, or 48:3. This means that Orinda must occur in 48:2, a month earlier. Also, the [[Orinda campaign]] lasts a month, meaning that the [[raid on Orinda]] occurred in 48:1.</ref>

{{Quote|Six months after Daala relinquished her command, Pellaeon made an aggressive lunge at the New Republic by seizing the small planet Orinda.|[[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]]|<ref name="TNEC" />}}
In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], a '''battle''' took place in the [[Orinda system/Legends|Orinda system]] between forces of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Shortly after the formation of the Remnant, new [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] struck at Orinda as a show of force, hoping to demonstrate to the New Republic that the Empire was very much alive. He first took the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Reaper (Executor-class)|''Reaper'']] to [[Borosk/Legends|Borosk]] to recruit [[Turr Phennir/Legends|Turr Phennir]] and the [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Group]], and Pellaeon and Phennir subsequently captured Orinda and six [[Star system/Legends|systems]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|coreward]] along the [[Entralla Route/Legends|Entralla Route]]. Emissaries to the New Republic asking them for the Remnant's new borders to be respected were shunned, and the [[Orinda campaign]] was launched.<ref name="Warfare" />
